scope: Reviewed products in stores.json; complete body sections are separate from small components.

roles.head: Physical head housings or head assemblies.
roles.torso: Structural body or frame intended to carry other parts. Wheeled driving bases belong primarily to legs.
roles.arms: Complete manipulation arm assemblies or kits including structural links.
roles.legs: Complete locomotion bases or leg assemblies.
roles.support: Internal electronics, power, orientation sensing, or adapters without a standalone anatomical role.
roles.whole_robot: A complete robot or complete robot kit spanning several body roles. Do not imply it is a single limb.
roles.actuators: Bare motors, servos and motor-only kits; not complete limbs.
roles.sensors: Sensing components, separate from physical head assemblies.
roles.wheels: Individual wheels and casters, separate from complete mobile bases.

policy: Roles are researched builder suggestions, not vendor anatomical labels or proof of physical compatibility. Secondary roles are optional alternative uses; they do not represent extra products. Preserve purchased scope: kits, sets, bare components, and excluded parts. Prices retain their original capture date.
